#### **A.2. The Tactile Axis - Texture as Truth**
Contains Biological (Chitinous, Sebaceous, Tumid, Viscid, Cartilaginous, Membranous, Cyanotic, Edematous) and Synthetic/Industrial (Chrome-Flesh, Hyper-smooth, Frictionless, Cold-polished) textures.
